summary: Closed compose_wc and compose_wc_right (2 of 4 sorry sites) in Composition.lean. Both use per-index ownership classification with pivot_chain_order for cross-interval pairs and sub-strategy dispatch for same-side pairs. 2 degenerate case sorries remain (lines 98 and 112) -- when no carrier point exists in the right/left sub-interval [d,y'] or [x',d]. These require restructuring the merged response to avoid same_order_type violations at RIGHT indices with differing M-values but equal N-values.
blocking_issues: Degenerate case (no point in sub-interval): When d = y', all RIGHT N-values collapse to d, forcing same_order_type to require all RIGHT M-values equal -- which Spoiler can violate. The fix likely requires modifying the merged response a' in the degenerate case to use the left strategy's a'_L for all indices, but this may require proving a'_L k = d for RIGHT k (derivable from hcond_L at boundary) and then showing the modified merged game tuple satisfies the winning condition with the y boundary adjusted.
